author: Codex, tasks
findings: The baseline MCP instructions combine every workflow in one long text, while projects already select independent column and task-type templates.
Goal status was based on a separately persisted close moment, so a goal with all tasks done could still be In Progress.
Task comments could store a conversation but did not identify questions, immutable offered choices or the provenance of a human answer.
Task modifications cloned and replaced the entire row; concurrent comments and task updates could overwrite one another.

prompts.storage: Optional JSON prompt lists on existing template rows; legacy null or missing fields resolve to empty lists.
prompts.anchors: Todo and Done remain fixed columns, but can have prompts.
prompts.version: SHA-256 over scope, template ID, target, text and output requirement.
prompts.analysis_links: Templates can require attached analysis-file references at stage exit or task-type completion.

goals.source_of_truth: The same board snapshot and non-deleted tasks used by progress counters.
goals.completion: A nonempty goal is Done when every task is Done; archived tasks still count.
goals.reopening: An unfinished added or reopened task makes the goal active and clears its projected closure timestamp.
goals.legacy: An explicitly closed empty legacy goal retains its manual state; newly created empty goals do not automatically close.
goals.transition_time: Automatic completion/reopening clocks and system events are stored atomically with the triggering task; this prevents a removed blocker from backdating completion.

decisions.storage: Questions and answers share the task row with its comment history, so one upsert persists both.
decisions.identity: A stable per-task request key makes retries idempotent; each question has a stable decision ID.
decisions.history: Original action, wording and options remain unchanged after answer or cancellation.
decisions.provenance: Authenticated board answers use ui; chat replies use agent_reported; imports retain imported:<original-source> and validate immutable history invariants.
decisions.blocking: An unanswered required question prevents the task from landing in Done; optional questions do not.
decisions.limits: The MCP server cannot intercept arbitrary client chats. The client must use the documented request/reply tools for task-related questions.

implementation.consistency: An async guard serializes task and goal read-modify-write operations; SDK parameterized data-modifying CTEs commit their rows atomically. Bounded ordered socket delivery runs after the guard is released.
implementation.rollout: Deploy backend before the UI. Added database fields are nullable. Existing templates, tasks and exports remain readable; no destructive migration is needed.

verification.postgres_integration: Passed separately against disposable local PostgreSQL 16: nullable migration preserves legacy rows; decision history round-trips; task/goal writes commit together and roll back together on constraint failure.
verification.wasm: Current UI passes cargo check for wasm32-unknown-unknown.
verification.backend_locked: cargo check --locked passes without changing dependency pins.
verification.review: Independent read-only code review: no remaining blocking findings after corrections.
verification.limits: No browser visual verification or production deployment was performed. One database test is ignored by default and was explicitly run against the disposable database.

acceptance_scenarios: Only the selected stage and task-type fragments are returned for one task.
Editing a fragment or its analysis-file requirement changes its content version.
Completing the last task automatically completes its goal; adding or reopening unfinished work reverses that state.
Retries do not duplicate a question or reply, and recommended choices never submit an answer automatically.
Free text and cancelled questions remain in history.
A person can answer directly in the task card, with identity and time supplied by the server.
Required unanswered questions and configured missing analysis links reject task completion or the relevant stage exit.
Project export/import preserves decision history and remaps analysis-document references.
